newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea absorbs 500 bln won through repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea absorbs 500 bln won through repos.

text.p: Bank of Korea said on Tuesday it absorbed 500 billion won from commercial banks through eight-day repurchase agreements.
"We have decided to soak up money in circulation due to abundant liquidity in the money market," a central bank official said.
He said the central bank was taking the action following a request by commercial banks to absorb liquidity.
"The move is unlikely to pressure the overnight call rates," the official said.
